setting.help: Use the three-row Captivea header on this website

button.name: action_cap_provision_header_menus
button.title: Adds the missing top bar menus and mega menus to this website, and translates them into every installed language. Existing menus are left untouched, and so are the labels already translated by hand. Run it again after installing a language.

button.name: action_cap_reset_mega_menu_panels
button.title: Puts the reference designs back on the Captivea panels, including the About one in the top bar, in every installed language. This is also how a panel gets translated: its content has to be rewritten for that.
button.confirm: This overwrites the content of the Captivea mega menu panels with the reference designs. Any change made on them in the website builder will be lost. The submenus of the About menu are deleted as well: Odoo does not allow a mega menu to have submenus, and the panel leads to the same pages. Continue?
